note.label: Prison House of Shadows

precepts.why:
“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord”: the north is North America. “for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven”: we are scattered everywhere. Then: “Deliver thyself, O Zion.” Zion right there refers to Judah.

“But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.” See that? Judah is the mount Zion which he loved. So Zechariah is saying, deliver thyself, O Judah, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon, with the so-called Caucasians, here in North America.

Judah has a work to do. Moses blessed him: “Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.” Judah would be the one going out to teach, to find the tribes and teach them the word of God. Not only would Judah be fighting in the system he lives in; a remnant of them would wake up, go out, teach and gather the twelve tribes of Israel. Help Judah against his enemies, against the white man.

And Jacob said: “Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies”: always struggling, always fighting, and not for no reason, but for the liberation of his people. “thy father’s children shall bow down before thee”, because Judah would be in the forefront teaching and gathering the tribes. “Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?” What happened? They gave us crack, heroin, feminism, bad education, all that the white man did to us, and Judah just rolled over and went to sleep. Now we just want money; the fight is gone. But the true liberation comes from the teachers of the Bible.

note.label: Prison House of Shadows

precepts.why:
Zion dwells with the daughter of Babylon. Who is the daughter of Babylon? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed.” The children of Edom, E-D-O-M, meaning red people. So Edom is called the daughter of Babylon, and Judah dwells with Edom here in North America.

How do we deliver ourselves? “And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” That's how we deliver ourselves: by not being partakers in the sins of America, not taking part in their religious ceremonies, their denominations, their political groups and traditions. It's the same thing 2 Corinthians 6:17 says. “For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities. Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works.” Who is the you? The tribes of Israel. America is going to get double what they did to us, just as the psalm says: “happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.”

It may look like we've been forsaken, but “Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.” We are in a low state, destitute, degenerate as a people: the twerkers, the drug dealers, the homeless ones, that's how it's put out there. Regardless of all that, God has not forsaken us. “For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel.” There is still hope for the pimps and the hoes, the prostitutes, the baby mama drama and the baby daddies.

“Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the Lord’s vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.” The way you flee is to deliver your soul, and the way you deliver your soul is through repentance and keeping God's commandments.

“But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.” The Lord chose the tribe of Judah, mount Zion. So we know that the Zion dwelling with the daughter of Babylon is Judah: deliver thyself, O Judah.

Zechariah is pointing out a remnant of Judah that is in North America. And what's so special about this group here? The house of David is here. You are going to find that thing out.

Why are they so hard on Judah here as opposed to Judah scattered elsewhere? The civil rights hearings of 1959 before the Senate, under the title American Negro problems, say it: the Negro question in the United States of America must be treated in its relation to the huge Negro masses oppressed and exploited by white imperialism in Africa and South America, and the Negroes of the United States are the most advanced section of the Negro population of the world and can play a decisive role in helping and leading the liberation movement of the Negro colonies. You have Negroes in Jamaica, Haiti, Africa, Saudi Arabia; Judah is everywhere, the southern kingdom is everywhere. But the white man examined all the Negro populations and said the American Negro is the most advanced.

Deacon Malachi brought it out: when Nebuchadnezzar came against Judah, they took the best of the best, the most educated. Esau isn't stupid; he knows that history. At Elmina Castle in Ghana, the tour guide said it himself: you never ask why the American black is more advanced; when they came to Africa, they took the best of them. Look right after slavery, without even reparations, how the blacks here advanced, and how they came and dropped bombs and destroyed them. That's why Esau always has his eye on the American blacks: that group here is more dangerous than all the other groups where the blacks are. And that's why the Lord said, “The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first.” It isn't Judah over in Africa or in Saudi Arabia. It's Judah here. This history you should be proud of.

precepts.why:
Zechariah says, “come forth, and flee from the land of the north”: flee from North America. “for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven”: all Israel scattered, like we read in Matthew 24 and James 1. Then he singles out one group: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.”

Many scriptures tell us that Zion represents the twelve tribes. But in this context, which Zion is it? Asaph answers: “But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.” That is the Zion right there.

So “Deliver thyself, O Zion” is talking about Judah: deliver yourself, Judah. That does not mean all the Judahites are in the land of the north; Judah was dispersed like all the other tribes. But God is pinpointing a particular group of Judah that would be in the land of the north, dwelling with the daughter of Babylon.

That fits the rest of the prophecy. In these last days the Lord raises up Judah first: the Lord “shall save the tents of Judah first”, and the blessing of Judah is, “Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people.” The voice of Judah is the teaching of Judah, carried to the other eleven tribes.

Zechariah says Zion, Judah, “dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” The key is who the daughter of Babylon is. The psalm names her: “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” The word rase means destroy it: destroy it even to the foundation.

Then the very next words: “O daughter of Babylon.” Notice what it is calling them now. It is calling Edom, the so-called white folks, the daughter of Babylon.

So the scripture lets you know Judah would live among Edom, and where? In the land of the north. That is why the Lord cries, “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north.” The group of Judah in North America is dwelling with the daughter of Babylon, the children of Edom who wanted Jerusalem razed to the ground.

And the Lord's word to that people is: “he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.” We are God's favorite, and the nations which spoiled us will answer for it.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

precepts.why:
Jacob called his sons to tell them “that which shall befall you in the last days,” and of Judah he said, “thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies.” That says two things: Judah will be fighting his enemy, and Judah will be living in close proximity to his enemy, who today is Esau, Edom. Zechariah 2 is the scripture that proves Judah will be living with that enemy.

“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” Then: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” Zion is the city of Judah. The daughter of Babylon, as Psalms 137 shows, is Edom, the Caucasian race. So Zion is dwelling with the daughter of Babylon: Judah living in the land of the north, in the house of his enemy.

That is the picture of Genesis 49:8. Judah’s hand in the neck of his enemies is Judah living with him and contending with him. In the 1960s and 70s there was the Black Panthers, Martin Luther King, Malcolm X, and many movements where Judah rose up and fought the so-called white man. “he stooped down, he couched as a lion,” and at one point it looked like he was about to strike.

But the lion lay back down: “as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?” Christ is the one who will rouse him up. Until then the word to Zion is to come forth and deliver himself from the daughter of Babylon he dwells with.

note.label: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

precepts.why:
“The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say”. The violence done to us, the Israelites, will be upon Babylon, and the Babylon here is America. But who is Zion, and where is Zion dwelling? Zechariah shows it is not just talking about the past, what Nebuchadnezzar did to us; it is talking about the future.

“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” The land of the north is America. Read on: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” And in Psalms 137 the daughter of Babylon is Edom. So Zion, the Israelites, is dwelling with white people in the land of the north, in America.

That means the violence in Jeremiah 51:35 is violence they will do to us in this land, and that blood will be upon them. Then: “Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee”. As we pray and ask him for vengeance and mercy, the Lord pleads our cause and takes vengeance on America for what they are doing to our people. So brothers, I know you are mad at what you see happening outside, but the Lord said he will take vengeance for us. “I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry. And Babylon shall become heaps”: a burnt heap.

Until then, Zion must deliver herself: stop the porn, the fornication and adultery, stop worshipping the white image of Christ, stop carrying grudges, hatred and envy, serve God and get right.

“For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.” Israel is still the apple of his eye, and the nations that spoiled Israel and did her harm have a grand payback coming when Christ returns.

David says “they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.” Zechariah calls to those same people: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon. For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.”

Deliver yourself, O Zion, dwelling with the daughter of Babylon. He that touches you touches the apple of God's eye. That is why he makes inquisition for blood and does not forget the cry of the humble: what was done to Israel was done to the apple of his eye.

He is sent unto the nations which spoiled us. So the Lord is a refuge for the oppressed, and all we must do is keep the commandments and have faith in Christ while he revenges the blood that has been shed.

precepts.text: "Ho, ho" is what he says coming through; flee from the land of the north where he rules over the Israelites, scattered abroad as the four winds.
precepts.point: The man of sin has to be revealed, and our people still do not want to acknowledge that Esau is the devil, not Christ. The white picture of Jesus is a deception; the Bible says nothing like that.

note.label: Psalm 52: The Boasting Man of Sin Revealed

precepts.why:
“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” Ho, ho is what he says coming through. Lucifer boasted he would sit on the mount of the congregation in the sides of the north, and here the Most High tells Israel to flee from the land of the north, where Esau rules over the Israelites who were spread abroad as the four winds of the heaven.

The boasting mighty man rules over the scattered congregation in the north for now, but the Most High is calling his people out of that land.

precepts.text: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon; this America is mystery Babylon.
precepts.point: The man of sin has to be revealed, and our people still do not want to acknowledge that Esau is the devil, not Christ. The white picture of Jesus is a deception; the Bible says nothing like that.

note.label: Psalm 52: The Boasting Man of Sin Revealed

precepts.why: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” Zion, Israel, is dwelling with the daughter of Babylon, and this America is mystery Babylon. The land of the north where the mighty man boasts over the congregation is the daughter of Babylon, and the Most High says deliver thyself out of her. That is the call to Israel scattered under Esau's rule.

precepts.text: Flee from the land of the north, meaning North America, and deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
precepts.point: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war. With his smooth policies, politics, religion, and lies our people believe him, but war is in his mind, designed to destroy us secretly, the same as was done to the Indians. We are to live peaceably with all men if possible and rely on the law of this Bible.

note.label: Psalm 120: In My Distress I Cried Unto the Lord

precepts.why:
“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord. Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” The land of the north is North America. Zion dwells with the daughter of Babylon, and that is what David is describing: “Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar! My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.”

The Israelites have long dwelt with Esau, Edom, the daughter of Babylon, who hate peace, hate us, and hate our guts. So the word is flee, come forth, deliver thyself.

precepts.text: He that touches us, Jacob the children of Israel, touches the apple of the Most High's eye.
precepts.point: As we go into chapters 48 and 49 we read more prophecies of the destruction of the other nations, for there has not been any nation that did not have a hand in spoiling us.

note.label: Jeremiah 47: The Prophecy Against the Philistines

precepts.why:
The word against the Philistines, the waters out of the north that overflow Gaza and Ashkelon and the sword of the Lord that cannot be quiet because he has given it a charge against the sea shore, is the first of the prophecies of the destruction of the other nations that go on through chapters 48 and 49. There has not been any nation that did not have a hand in spoiling us.

Zechariah says why they are all judged: “For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.” He that touches us, Jacob the children of Israel, touches the apple of the Most High's eye. The Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor, spoiled Israel, so the Lord spoils the Philistines, and the sword rests only where he has appointed it.

precepts.text: If they bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and say, We have sinned, and return unto thee with all their heart in the land of their enemies, and pray toward their land.
precepts.point: The deliverance comes by knowing who you are. There is a doctrine to it: acknowledge the fault, repent, and make supplication, and do it in the land of the enemy where you are.

note.label: Zechariah 2: The Measuring Line and the Apple of His Eye

precepts.why:
Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon. This is a future prophecy as well as a past one; the scriptures are twofold. And there is a doctrine to how Zion delivers herself. “If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near”.

“Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness; And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies”. Acknowledge the fault, repent and make supplication, and do it in the land of the enemy where you are, praying toward the land he gave to our fathers.

The deliverance comes by knowing who you are: spread abroad as the four winds of the heaven, in the land of the enemy, and told to bethink ourselves there.

precepts.text: They shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
precepts.point: Behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me. Israel does not have to lift a finger.

note.label: Zechariah 2: The Measuring Line and the Apple of His Eye

precepts.why:
He that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye. The nations that dealt with Israel harshly and put us in slavery, he will deal with them himself: I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants. “And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.”

Israel does not have to lift a finger. He shakes his hand, and those whose captives we were become our captives, and we rule over our oppressors.

precepts.text: The Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the Lord shall lead you.
precepts.point: Israel was scattered among the nations, so Israel is in the nations. The one the Lord shakes his hand at is the heathen, so the heathen are not who is being joined to him here.

note.label: Zechariah 2: The Measuring Line and the Apple of His Eye

precepts.why:
Many nations shall be joined to the Lord in that day, and shall be my people. Do not read that with a Christian mind, as though the other nations of the earth are being brought in. “And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the Lord shall lead you.”

Israel was scattered among the nations, so Israel is in the nations. The one the Lord shakes his hand at is the heathen, so the heathen are not who is being joined to him here; it is his people, gathered out of the nations where he scattered them.

precepts.text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad. The letter names who it is written to.
precepts.point: Israel was scattered among the nations, so Israel is in the nations. The one the Lord shakes his hand at is the heathen, so the heathen are not who is being joined to him here.

note.label: Zechariah 2: The Measuring Line and the Apple of His Eye

precepts.why:
“James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.” The letter names who it is written to: the twelve tribes scattered abroad.

Israel is in the nations. So the many nations joined to the Lord in that day are his people coming out of the nations where they are scattered, not the heathen he shakes his hand at.

precepts.text: I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.
precepts.point: Be silent, O all flesh, before the Lord: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.

note.label: Zechariah 2: The Measuring Line and the Apple of His Eye

precepts.why:
The Lord shall choose Jerusalem again. That Jerusalem is chosen is said over and over in the scriptures. “But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.”

He chose Jerusalem for his name, and David over his people Israel. Judah is his portion in the holy land, and Jerusalem is the city he chooses again.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 6 The 4 Horsemen

precepts.why:
The north country is Babylon the great, North America. “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north,” So the Lord is telling Israel to flee from the land of the north; this is North America. It is saying the same thing Revelation 18:4 says, come out from among her, my people, making reference to Babylon. Flee, meaning flee spiritually, mentally. “saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” Because he spread us worldwide; that is the four winds of the heaven.

“Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” Now he says deliver thyself, O Zion. Somebody may say, wait a minute, the daughter of Babylon, isn't that the ancient Cushites? No, it is not; Psalms 137 shows it is Edom. The land of the north is what you want to highlight: land of the north, North America. And that Zion right there, listen good, is mainly Judah.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 11 A Time Of Defamation

precepts.why:
Remember that Jerusalem is a people before it is a place. The angel said to rise and measure the temple and them that worship therein, but not the outer court given to the Gentiles. “I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.” This is Zechariah during the time of the Persian captivity. “Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.” The width and the length of Jerusalem. “And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him, And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein: For I, saith the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.” This is the people being delivered, wherein the Lord is our protector, just like when we came out of ancient Egypt he was a fire by night and a cloud by day.

“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord:” Zechariah is prophesying through the spirit of the Lord that the Israelites would be delivered from the land of the north; this is prophetic of North America. “for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” Although we were spread forth as the four winds of heaven, north, south, east and west, he is letting us know that from the land of the north there is going to be a major deliverance: from North America.

“Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” When it talks about the daughter of Zion it is talking about Judah first and foremost. And the daughter of Babylon is Edom: David in the spirit calls Edom the daughter of Babylon (Psalms 137:7-8). So it is letting you know that Judah would live with Edom; Judah would dwell with Edom. You have people saying there are no Israelites here in North America; you are dumb as a rock. That is how you know it is not talking so much about Benjamin: Benjamin is on the islands by themselves, Levi is on the islands, just like Ephraim, and the rest is Judah. That is why people make fun of Judah: we have no place to go; you live here with Esau. We have to dwell with Edom, and that is the prophecy right there.

“For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you:” The Lord is sending Christ after us regarding the nations which spoiled us, because they are going to get destroyed, these nations that touched us. “for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.” When it says we are the apple of his eye, that means we are his favourite, his chosen. He will shake his hand upon them and they shall be a spoil to their servants: the people who have touched us, Edom, are going to be destroyed.

points: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord. The north is North America. So we are scattered everywhere.
